Entry at 830.20 from scan with risk ~23 points (2.8%), targeting 3.7% to T1. Debate verdict was 'watch' due to moderate conviction, but technical setup and news alignment justify a starter position with tight stop below recent swing low.

Debate gave it 4/10 conviction due to pullback nature, but news support and clear technical levels make it a controlled-risk trade; stop placed below EMA20 support.

Pharma sector showing strength, and this is a fresh breakout not in debate list, providing diversification.
